title: GTA6's Shadow: What Excited Us in the Latest Galaxies Showcase
description: As the industry gives GTA 6 a wide berth, the latest Galaxies Showcase still delivers plenty of exciting game announcements to check out this autumn.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Autumn Chill and the Industry's 'GTA 6 Effect'

You can smell it in the air, can't you? The chill in your nostrils and the earthy whiff as leaves fall and the sun departs for another year. Yes, autumn is here, meaning we are teetering on the cavernous hole of near-nothingness as the entire games industry gives GTA 6 the widest berth imaginable. With the monumental release of Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster looming on the horizon, developers and publishers across the board are strategically adjusting their schedules.

However, that doesn't mean there isn't plenty to look forward to in the meantime. While the industry clears the runway for GTA 6, alternative showcases and events are stepping up to keep players engaged and excited.

## Highlights from the Galaxies Showcase

The latest edition of the Galaxies Showcase has successfully thrown quite a few intriguing items onto the gaming community's radar. Spanning a runtime of nearly two hours, the event was packed with announcements, reveals, and updates.

According to media reports from Eurogamer, a total of 11 games and announcements from the showcase managed to catch the eyes of critics and players alike. While viewers with a spare couple of hours can certainly watch the entire presentation from start to finish, the sheer volume of announcements highlights that creativity and exciting new projects are still thriving, even as the industry prepares for the biggest launch of the decade.

## Editor's Take
It is fascinating to watch the gaming ecosystem adapt to the shadow of GTA 6. While major publishers might be hesitant to compete directly, events like the Galaxies Showcase prove that there is still plenty of room for diverse, intriguing games to capture our attention and keep the autumn gaming season vibrant.
